༄༅/ /bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub kyi lag len dmar khrid brjed byang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub kyi lag len dmar khrid brjed byang bzhugs so//

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub lag len dmar khrid brjed byang zhes bya ba/ bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa/ bsnyen pa thems shing*/ rim gnyis la drod rtags thob pa'i slob dpon la/ slob ma skal snod dang ldan pas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gzhung legs par tshugs par byas pa'i dbang sgrub kyi gzhi 'dzin pa'i tshe/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba'i chos ni/ gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par/ dgra srung gi go mtshon/ bgegs srung ba'i rdzas sngags/ nad srung ba'i sman dang cha byad/ 'tsho chas kyi bza' btung*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod rdzas/ sgrub rdzas| bsnyen rdzas/ rten rdzas/ dam rdzas/ gar 'cham gyi yo byad/ tshogs chas rnams ma tshang ba med cing kha na ma tho ba dang bral ba/ de yang sgrub chen gyi yun nyis ldab tsam du 'dangs par bsags/ dpon slob thams cad kyis spyi bshags/ sāts+tsha/ chu gtor/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /gsung sgrog /mdo sgrub/ bsang rngan/ nye'u 'don/ lam 'phrang bsal ba/ gser skyems/ sbyin gtong sogs dge ba'i tshogs 'grub tshad la 'bad/ srung ma'i bskang ba dang mnga' gsol ci mang bya/ na raka skong bshags dang*/ dge 'dun la chos ston drangs/ yig brgya bzla ba sogs bya/ de nas slob ma rnams la rnal 'byor rgyun dbang bskur nas/ las thams cad pa 'dod rgyal lam/ bgegs mthar byed dang*/ drag sngags so bdun pa bzlar gzhug /gnas kyi shar du phar phyin/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang gshegs/ byang du rin po che'i tog gzungs rnams sgrog /tshogs 'khor dang bskang bshags bya/ slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa kha gso zhag bdun la sogs pa bya'o// khro ging zhub can rnga rol thun rdzas bdug sogs kyi sbyor bas sgrub khang phyi ru bgegs bskrad bya/ de rjes sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ dbang du bya ba/ sbyang ba/

bzung zhing bgegs bskrad pa rnams bya/ de nas gnas khang gi phyogs bzhir phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ spro na skabs 'dir sa 'dul la rnga 'cham dkyus ltar bya ba lag len yin/ gom pa bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i sar rgyal tho btsugs la byin gyis brlabs| spyan drangs/ srog snying nas bzung zhing bka' bsgo bya/ las kyi gnyer gtad/ de nas nang du log la dam sri'i liṅga bri zhing dong du gzhug |ting 'dzin bsgom/ dgug bstim/ sngags bzla mnan cing 'dul sbyong gi bro dang rgyas gdab bya/ de rjes nang mtshams bcad cing phyi nang gi sgo byang gdags pa ni/ rten bca' sgo byang la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bde 'dus nas ma gsungs kyang gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen nas 'dir 'gengs la phyi ma gshin rje chos rgyal ni dkyus ltar/ zhing spyan drangs/ mnga' gsol las kyi gnyer gtad cing bka' bsgo bya/ de nas stegs bu'i sa la ma ṭaṃ gi gzugs bya zhing spros pa la dga' na zor ba brgyad po zor 'cham dkyus ltar byas rjes bsgral/ gnas gzhan du spar/ khog pa bros sbyang*/ smon lam btab/ khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs/ ma traṃ gi gzugs de'i snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu rgyar 'dom gang dpangs su khru gang pa legs par bca'/ der thig gdab pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs shing las thig man ngag lag len ltar gdab/ lha sta gon ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha gnas rnams su dri'i thig le bya/ 'bru tshom bkod/ mchod gtor sman raka bsham/ dkyil 'khor dgu bskyed pa nas bstod pa'i bar las byang gzhung bsrang*/ de rjes lha la snyan gsan dbab pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen ltar bya/ de nas bum pa sta gon ni/ lha bum dgu/ khrus bum bzhi/ las bum rnams brab bdug gis bgegs bskrad mgul chings dkri/ rdzas dang bum pa bca' tshul sogs bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen dang dbang bskur nas 'byung ba ltar bcas la/

lha bum dgu po dbus dang phyogs mtshams so sor bkod nas lha bskyed pa nas bstod pa'i bar las gzhung bsrang*/ lha rnams kyi yab yum sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bab pas bum pa gang bar bsam/ lha so so'i sngags brgya stong ci 'grub dang*/ drag sngags so bdun pa bzla/ las bum du bgegs mthar byed dam 'dod rgyal bskyed bzlas bya/ khrus bum bzhir rdo rje rnam 'joms bskyed bzlas kyang bya'o// bum lha rnams mi zhu bar bzhag |yang lha bum sta gon stabs cig tu byed na/ lha bum dgu po dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu so so'i steng du bkod nas lhan cig tu lha bskyed bzlas byas na zor yang ba la phan no// de nas dkyil 'khor dang bum pa rnams yol bas bsgribs la/ gter gzhung du slob ma sta gon 'di dbang dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i gong du gsungs kyang 'dir bya ba phyag len rnam par dag pa'o// dbang chog rin chen phreng bar yod pa ltar 'dir bya/ de rjes dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod/ tshogs 'khor lhag ma mchod bstod bzod gsol rnams gzhung ltar byas nas/ tshom bu'i lha rnams badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭhas nam mkhar bteg la tshom bu dang mchod pa sogs bsdu/ bum pa rnams mchod pa dang bcas dben par bzhugs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ rdul tshon byin gyis brlabs/ mthong brgyud ltar bri/ grub na dkyil 'khor la lan gsum sogs bskor zhing yig brgya bzlas pa chad lhag bskang*/ de rjes rgyan dgram pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mañdzi'am| khri'u'i steng du bum pa rnams spos dang rol mos spyan drangs la dbus su phyogs mtshams ma nor bar bkod/ de rnams kyi steng du thod pa mtshan ldan dgu'i nang du 'khor lo bris pa sman 'bru rin po che bkang la bzhag pa'i steng du/ lha so so'i srog rten man ngag ltar gur phub pa dang*/ gzhan yang bris sku rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tsaka li/

hūm̐ yig /shel rdo zur brgyad dam drug pa/ gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lcags ri la e bcu'i nang du phyogs skyong bcu'i gzugs la dgug bstim byas pa'i snying gar khro bcu'i las phur dar gyi cod pan btags pa bcu/ khro bo bcu'i byin brlabs dbang bskur gzi byin bskyed/ sngags bzlas nas brgyad po phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og gnyis shar nub tu btab la bzhag /dkyil 'khor dgu po re rer so so'i phur bu dar gyi cod pan btags pa re dang mar me re re/ dpal gtor dkar dmar gyis brgyan cing dar gyi gdugs phub pa re re sman raka dang bcas pa bkod/ sman raka gtor ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mi bde na phyogs mtshams brgyad dang*/ gtso bo'i sman raka gtor ma'i shar du bshams kyang nyan/ dkyil 'khor gyi zur rnams su ral gri dar nag gi cod pan dang lha so so'i sngags dar dmar la bris pa btags pa bzhi 'am brgyad/ logs rnams su mda' rgod sgro ma la dar sna lnga'i 'phur lce dang me long rma bya'i sgros brgyan pa bzhi'am brgyad/ steng du tshon skud kyi dra ba rtsibs brgyad ris dang*/ logs rnams su dra ba bsnol mar bris/ steng du zhing gi gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ logs rnams su ba dan dang*/ mtshams rnams su dur khrod kyi yo byad sna tshogs pa bshams/ mtha'i phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma bzhi/ shar sman mchod/ lhor baṃ chen/ nub tu tshe gtor/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ byang du las bzhi'i phur bu rnams so sor gnas ma 'chor bar bkod/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dgu la bskang ba'i gtor ma rgyas pa re re/ bka' sdod la gcig /brtan ma'i gtor ma/ chad mdo/ sde bdun/ zla gam/ dza gad bum pa/ phyi nang gi dbang rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad/ gsang dbang gi rdzas thod pa bzang por byang sems dkar dmar mngar gsum chang dang sbyar ba'i kha dar sna lngas bkab pa'i steng du me long la sin+dhu ra'i dal bris pas bkab pa/

dbang gsum pa'i rten dngos sam bris 'bur gyi rig ma la sogs pa dbang dang sgrub pa'i dam rdzas gang dgos pa ma tshang ba med pa'ang gang 'thad du bkod legs par bshams/ sgrub khang steng du rgyal mtshan lnga'am gcig gi nang du gtsug tor dri med dbus gdugs dkar shar rnam rgyal lho 'bar ba nub 'khor bsgyur byang du gzhug /rdul tshon gyi phyi rol du gdab phur brgya rtsa brgyad/ dbang phyug gi rtsang phur 'di gdab phur nang du bkod na legs/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi phur bu phyogs bzhir bdun bdun mdog mthun yang bshams/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang rtsang phur rnams 'byor na rab phur bu legs/ ma 'byor na rtsang phur sked pa rgya mdud ma byas kyang chog /phyi skor du phyi'i mchod pa/ chu dang 'o ma sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ chu gtsang la tsan+dan sbags pa'i zhabs bsil/ chu dang thang las skyes pa'i me tog sna tshogs/ a ka ru dang spos dkar nag sogs bdug spos/ 'bru mar dang rtsi mar gyi snang gsal/ chu gtsang sman dang dkar gsum bran pa'i dri chab/ dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sna'i phye dang sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ dril bu cha lang ting shag pi wang sogs rol mo/ 'bru sman rin po che'i tshom bu so bdun bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid bdun/ 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa rnams dang*/ nang mchod/ rgyu mchog bsgral ba'i dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen gu gul dang sbyar ba'i spos/ tshil chen til dang sbyar ba'i mar me/ dri chu la a mṛ ta btab pa'i dri chab/ sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas/ rkang gling thod pa'i rol mo rnams so// gsang mchod/ skyes pa dang bud med 'du 'phrod byed pa'am de dag gi byang sems dkar dmar/ bsgral mchod gdab las nas 'byung ba ltar bcas pa'i liṅga gdab phur dang bcas pa/ sman mchod/ thod pa mtshan ldan du chang la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar ba/ rak+ta'i mchod pa/ bhan+dha lcang lo can du rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i rak+ta/

mchod gtor/ dpal gyi gtor ma dkar dmar gyis brgyan cing*/ sha khrag rus pa spos sogs bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs pas bran pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyis spras pa mchod pa de rnams rab lha grangs/ 'bring dkyil 'khor gyi grangs| tha na'ang phyogs bzhir tshar re re cis kyang bsham/ grwa bzhir mar me tshe 'bar bzhi bzhag /sgab skor stag lpags la dril bu/ g.yel kha/ phur chung*/ mi snying dang*/ mi lpags sogs 'phyang 'phrul dang rus pa'i dra ba dra phyed btags pas bskor/ phyogs mtshams su rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan/ steng du gdugs/ bla bre sogs bkod mdzes shing brjid chags par bya/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi bhan+dha'am/ bhan+dha dgu ga nas tshangs pa'i dmu thag thog steng du drangs/ thog steng du ku sha'i chun po'i 'og tu dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor me long la bris pa dang*/ de 'og tshangs pa rgyu skar gyis bskor ba'i pho brang la btags/ dkyil 'khor bsham pa yang bang rim yod med gang bde byas pas rung*/ bshams zin nas kyang gu gul gyis bdug phyi rol du yol ba sogs kyis mi mthong bar bya'o// mchod gtor sman raka ḍā ma ru rdor dril khrus las kyi bum pa sogs nyer mkho rnams slob dpon gyi nye logs su bshams/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ lha nye bar bsnyen pa/ lha dang gnyis su med par sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub blang ba dang gsum las/ dang po ye shes kyi lha nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ de ltar zin nas mched lcam rnams chas gzab gyon nas sgrub khang gi sgor 'dus nas/ kye/ sgo ba ging chen sogs gter gzhung du med kyang gzhan nas 'dir bskang ba phyag len ltar zhu ba dang lan ldon/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus bya/ nang nas slob dpon gyis bgegs gtor sbyin/ nang gi sgo drung du drag po'i shing gi thab gru gsum brtsegs la me sbar/ nang nas mtshams gcod las gzhung ltar gyer zhing rol mo drag po dang bcas khro 'bag sogs ging chas can gyis tsha rngam bya zhing sgo dbye/

thun brab/ chu gtor/ me la mchong zhing slob dpon gyi mdun du tshogs la 'khod/ me tog bkram bsdus/ sngon 'gro thun mong gi chos bzhi bshad| maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bka' yi byung tshul rgyas par bshad/ slob dpon nas bzung thod pa mtshan ldan du skyems drangs shing mnga' gsol dang las 'dzin so so'i bsko bzhag gi gnyer gtad bya| dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol zhing gdab/ rang rang gi gral la 'khod/ mched lcam byings rnams kyang gral go ma log par 'khod la/ brda sgo dbye ba dang*/ brda phyag bya ba las gzhung ltar bya/ brda sbyar zhing bsre/ sman mchod byin gyis brlabs la/ bsre mnan bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bskyed/ sdig pa bsregs/ bgegs bskrad/ thugs rjes bzung zhing spro ba bskyed| skyabs su 'gro/ sems bskyed zhu zhing byin brlabs/ smon lam btab cing sdig pa bshags/ me tog dor/ gsol ba gdab/ mig dbye/ dam tshig 'bogs/ dam ma 'dres pa bsre zhing 'dres zin rnams mnan/ bla ma la gtang rag 'bul/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub rten bkram par gzi byin bskyed/ byin brlabs/ spyan drangs shing dgod do// 'dir phur bu gtso bo'i grangs mnyam zhig slar 'god par gsungs kyang spro na bya/ mi spro na sngar bkod zin na des chog /de rjes las gzhung bsrang zhing tshogs 'khor byas la/ mchod pa ni lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa lha dang gnyis su med par bsgrub pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa sku gsung thugs/ sku phyag rgya chen po/ gsung sngags kyi sgra/ thugs ye shes lngar gsal btab la/ dang po zhi ba'i 'dzab bgrang*/ de rjes zhi ba'i 'dzab 'bul bstod pa bya/ de bzhin du che mchog nas drag sngags bar rigs 'gre/ dkyil 'khor re re la 'dzab stong stong thon nas bstod pa dang sman mchod re bya/ de lta bu lha grub pa'i rtags ma mthong bar du dkar nag gi mtshams gung gnyis te thun bzhi'am/ nyin gsum mtshan gsum ste thun drug tu rdo rje rgyal pos bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa las mi g.yel bar bya/

phyogs bzhi'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i bsnyen 'dzab kyi gnyer bya/ las kyi rgyal thebs kyi gtsos las byang gzhung bsrang*/ nyin mtshan kun tu sngags ma chad par thun res mo bya/ rab thun bcu gnyis/ 'bring thun drug /tha ma'ang nyin mtshan gnyis la las byang tshar re nges par ma chag par tshogs drangs bcas pa re bya ba gal che/ thun gsar rnying brje len skabs 'khar rnga sogs kyis brda sbyar/ thun pa rnying pa rnams la tshogs drangs lhag gtor btang*/ gsar pa rnams sgrub khang phyi sgor rnam 'joms kyi khrus bya/ ging chas dang ldan pas thun 'phang*| rol mo dang bcas bgegs bskrad sgrub khang bskor zhing nyul le bskrad/ sgo byang gyer/ gar chas rol mo dang bcas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing byin dbab/ mchod bstod bya/ sgrub pa po byings rnams kyis drag sngags so bdun pa bzla/ rnal 'byor pa nus ldan gyis khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor bsgom bzlas rgyun du bya/ nyin mtshan gung gnyis la tshe 'gugs bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang ngam byang shar du khrus bum bzhi la rnam 'joms kyi bum sgrub rgyun ma chad par bsgrub/ sgrub po rnams 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi tshe kha skong yig brgya ci 'grub bzla/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus dang grib sel la 'bad/ nangs re bzhin bsang rngan rgyun du gtang*/ grwa lnga dang gser 'od sgrog /sde bdun sogs chos srung rnams la gsol mchod bya/ mdangs bskang dri med bshags rgyud sogs bklag /sgrub pa'i tshe mched lcam rnams bying zhing 'thib/ dpa' zhum na nga rgyal bskyed/ 'dzab bro bya/ res 'ga' bag grang zhing bying chung na dam rdzas myang zhing rgyan gos gzab| glu gar rol mo dang bcas dkyil 'khor bskor ba dang*/ sgrub khang bskor zhing byin dbab/ gal te bar chad kyi mtshan ma mthong na/ sāts+tsha gdab/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang tshogs dang bskang ba bya/ srung 'khor bsgom/ mdos glud gtang*/ tshe sgrub bya/ dus thams cad du spyod pa bag dang ldan par bya/

spyod rtsing bag med mi bya/ thun bar rnams su tshogs mchod dang*/ gdab las lhag mchod sgrub pa ma grol bar tshogs lhag thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'dabs byang shar du bsags la/ grol ba'i tshe gtor 'bul skabs su lhan cig khang steng du 'bul ba yin/ sogs kyis lha mnyes par bya/ spro na skabs 'dir rnga 'cham dang drug 'cham sogs rgyas par bya/ de thams cad 'jig rten 'dir snang gi chos brgyad dang khengs grags kyis ma bslad par gsang sngags rim gnyis kyi lta spyod dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bya ba gal che/ mched lcam byings kyang nyin mo bza' btung zin nas dung ngam 'khar rnga sogs kyis brda sbyar la/ sgrub khang sgo drung du 'dus te rnam 'joms kyi khrus bya/ khro ging sogs rol mo bcas pas thun brab bgegs bskrad/ gu gul bdug nang nas sgo byang gyer thams cad nang du tshogs la ging pho mos gral bar nyul zhing bgegs bskrad/ dkyil 'khor bskor zhing byin dbab/ gtor 'bul bya/ thams cad kyis 'dzab yun ring du bgrang ba la 'bad/ tshul de lta bus nyin mtshan le dbar med par bsgrub pa ni don gyi gtso bo yin gyi/ bsgrubs pas grub rtags rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du grub rtags brtan po lan gsum yan chad ma mthong bar dngos grub dang dbang gi cho ga byas kyang bye ma btsir bas mar khu mi 'byung bar nyid dang mtshungs bar zad do// phyag len 'ga' zhig tu dbang rgyas pa 'di'i bar gsungs kyang bsnyen sgrub chen mo'i pra khrid ṭī ka dngos grub yongs rdzogs kyi dbang gi skabs bya bar gsungs/ rtags brtan po mthong nas tho rangs skya rengs 'char du nye ba na/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor pa la dngos grub len chog byas la dngos grub kyi dbang rnams bdag 'jug blang*/ gsum pa sgrub pa chen po gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub blang ba ni/ nam langs pa dang sdom pa 'og ma tsam yang ma thob pa rnams la bsnyen gnas sam skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa brda 'phrod nges su byin la/

sgrub dbang bya ste dngos grub kyi rdzas bsham pa ni/ dkyil 'khor steng gi thod pa dgu'i nang du dngos grub gsol byang bris la bcug /dkyil 'khor gyi mthar skor ram mdun du/ bhan+dha mtshan ldan du chang la dza gad sbyar ba dang*/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa mang por rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi zla kham dang*/ zla khrom dang*/ zla rgyas dang*/ tshe dang*/ gal dang*/ thun dang*/ 'jam des dang*| maṃ sa dang*/ dza gad dang*/ dza ti dang*/ kun tu rgyu dang*/ spang na skyes dang*/ se thog dang*/ thud dang*/ 'bras chan/ 'khur ba/ 'o ma/ la du/ shing thog sna tshogs/ mngar gsum la sogs pa bza' bca' btung ba ma tshang ba med pa thams cad kyang gtsang ma btab// gu gul tshil chen dang sbyar ba'i spos btul/ lcang lo'i g.yab mo bya/ rol mo dang bcas mched lcam rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya/ byin dbab/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams las gzhung gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar byin brlabs/ dkyil 'khor gtso sngags rnams 'dod gsol gyi sngags btags pa brgya brgya bzla/ dmigs pa bya/ slar gnad la dbab/ stong tshigs kyi mchod pa bya zhing blang*/ dngos grub bsdu zhing bstim/ dngos grub thob pa'i yon tan brjod/ sbyor sgrol gyi las bstan pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen du gsungs pa 'dir blang la sbyin/ bye brag tu 'gro don nus pa'i slob ma la sgrub rdzas kyis dbang bskur ba ni/ sgrub rdzas kyi dbang slob mas zhu/ slob dpon gyis gnang ba byin la khas blangs la sbyin/ de rjes yongs rdzogs kyi dbang ni sgrub dbang sbrag na dbang chog rin chen phreng ba dang rim pa dbang gi sgrub pa dbang bum gyi byang bur gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa nas bzung*/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar rnams dus bzhir dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir rdzogs par bskur ba yin la/ sgrub dbang mi sbrag na rnal 'byor rgyun dbang tsam bskur yang rung bar snyam mo// de nas thun mong du shis pa brjod pa dang*/

smon lam btab cing dngos grub kyi rdzas zhal zas rnams cha bdun du bgos la so sor 'bul zhing*/ mched lcam yongs la drangs shing longs spyad nas rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pa yang bya'o// bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang chog tu yod pa 'dir sbyar na legs so// sman sgrub la sogs pa'i sgrub phran rnams dang*/ rkyen zlog khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog sogs gang byed kyang skabs 'dir bya dgos pa yin no// gsum pa mjug ni/ gtor ma bgo bar 'os pa rnams cha gsum du bgo// cha gcig zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tu mchod par 'bul/ cha gcig bzhag /cha gcig gter du sba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu/ rdul tshon rnams mtha' nas dbus su bsdus la bum par blugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan dbang ldan mtshams nas rim gyis rdzas rnams bsdus te/ sa stegs kyi steng du rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i steng du slob ma rnams kyi gos rnams brtsegs pa'i khri la slob dpon bzhugs te brtan bzhugs 'bul/ de rjes sgo byang gi lha la gtor ma phul lha gshegs la sgo byang bsdus te nang mtshams grol/ bum par blugs pa'i rdul tshon rta'am khyogs la bzhag /gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan spos rol mos sna drangs/ mtsho'am chu mig gam/ 'bab chu'i 'gram du spyan drangs| chu ngogs su klu'i dkyil 'khor lag len ltar tshon dkar pos bris/ klu rnams spyan drangs/ mchod cing bstod 'o ma'i gtor ma phul/ rdul tshon klu rnams kyi mchod pa bya ba'i slad du rgya mtshor spyan drangs par bsam la chu bor dor/ bum pa chus bkang la gtang rag btang zhing bzod par gsol/ mar me smon lam bya/ lus bsrung*/ go bgo/ gshegs par 'os pa'i gtor ma rnams dang tshogs lhag rnams sgrub khang steng du rol mo spro na gshegs par 'os pa'i gtor ma rnams sreg spos rol mo dang dar 'phan sogs kyis sna drangs/

rnga 'cham rnams gtor ma'i rjes su lam 'gros kyis 'don/ gtor ma rnams thog brtsegs sogs kyi steng du mchod pa sman raka dang bcas te bsham la rnga 'cham gyi gtor bshags 'gros yan chad dkyus ltar byas rjes/ gtor bshags 'gros kyi gong der gtor ma rnams la sman raka sgron nas chad mdo dang brtan skyong las gzhung ltar btang la gtor ma rnams gtsang sar phul nas/ gtor bshags 'gros yan chad rnga 'cham dkyus ltar byas la nang du bsdu ba phyag len rnam dag yin no// dar 'phan/ ba dan/ bsang dud dang bcas chad mdo dang brtan skyong las gzhung ltar gyer la gtor 'bul rgyas par bya/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /zhag bdun nam lnga'am gsum du ngal gso zhing gnas bsrung*/ ngo grang dang mi 'phrad/ de rjes phyogs bzhi'i rgyal chen la gtang rag gi gtor ma 'bul/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu byas la/ phyi mtshams har 'don min par khad kyis grol zhing dga' ston dang glu gar bya ba yin no// tshul de rnams ni bsnyen sgrub chen mo'i pra khrid ṭī kas khog phub cing gzhung bsrang*/ dbang chog rin chen phreng ba dang*/ rim pa dbang gi sgrub pa dbang bum gyi byang bu dang dus kyi bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa rnams lto bsdebs nas go rim ma 'phyug par lag tu blang ba'i gnad dam pa yin gyi/ la la dag gis sgrub pa'i yig cha sna re tsam dang*/ dbang rkyang pa re thob nas gzhan la bka' brgyad kyi sgrub dbang bgyis so zhes blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams las ches cher 'phags pa yin no// yang brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma la khrid lung sogs chos bka' yongs rdzogs ma grub bar dkyil 'khor mi gshegs na'ang*/ gtor ma bgo ba'i gong der khrid lung sogs bya zhing*/ de dag gi ring la 'dzab bsnyen ci nus la 'bad/ tshogs dang bskang ba sogs bya/ khrid lung grub nas rjes kyi rim pa rnams gong bzhin bya ba yang phyag len dpyis phyin pa yin no/// /

༈ /da ni sman sgrub kyi lag len dmar khrid ni/ sman rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag dang bcas pa tshang bar bsags/ rlan yod pa rnams ma rul ba bskam/ de rjes dkyil 'khor dbus su bhan+dha lnga bkod pa'i dbus mar dri chen/ shar du byang sems/ lhor maṃ sa/ nub tu rak+ta/ byang du dri chu rnams so so'i rtsa ba/ dbang po'i rgyal po lnga/ blon po lnga/ sman rgyal po lnga/ blon po lnga/ dri'i rgyal po lnga/ blon po lnga/ gzhan yang chu dang 'o ma dang*| phabs la sogs pa sna grangs 'dzoms pa rnams thod pa lnga dang de'i skor du gzhung ltar bsham/ dam rdzas phab rgyun dam pa gong ma rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman dang*/ rang lugs brgyud pa dam sel ma zhugs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gdung dang ril bsrel la sogs pa phye mar byas pa chu dang sbyar ba bhan+dha mtshan ldan du blugs pa bhan+dha lnga po'i steng ngam/ nyung na dbus kyi bhan+dha'i steng du bkod/ kha bkab gzung thag btags la tshur drangs/ de rjes zhi khro'i las byang gzhung bsrang*/ sman la byin dbab/ slar zhi ba'i las gzhung bsrangs nas/ lha re la 'dzab brgya re phul rjes| khrol bu rnams dam pa rigs brgya/ de nyid rigs lnga/ gsang chen rigs gcig rnams kyis rim bzhin sbyangs/ rtog pa gzhom/ bdud rtsi'i pho brang gdab/ de nyid rigs lngas bzhu btul bya/ de ltar khrol sgrub zhag gsum sogs zin nas/ sman rnams bhan+dha dbus mar bsdu/ gsang chen rigs gcig gis sbyangs/ slob dpon gyis khrol bu spor/ 'dul sbyong ni yab yum gyis dkyil 'khor shar du sman 'thag /lhor dar tshags la drangs/ nub tu phye ma la rlan rnams nam dus bsil drod dang bstun par bskol bas sbru/ 'bri mar rul sungs kha tsha med pa'i mar khu khyor gang yang blug /gar sla sbar bcang byas na mi zhig tsam bya/ grang du bcal/ phabs rgyun rnams bsres la mi rkang gis 'dre nges shes par dkrug /byang du slar sman rnams nam dus dang bstun pa'i drod btags la phabs rnams blugs la dkrug

/dar ram gos sam ras gtsang mi rje'ur bstsal/ rus sbal khog par pad+ma sa bon bris pa kha gyen du bstan pa'i steng du mo thod mtshan ldan la yum gyi sa bon bris pa kha gyen du phyogs pa'i steng du bdud rtsi'i snod bzhag /pho thod mtshan ldan phyi nang du sngags bris pa kha dbub la bkab/ zhing gi rgyu ma'i tshon skud lngas rgya gram du bcing*/ gzung thag lnga btags pa phyir drangs la dar zab mang pos dril la rgyas btab/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du bal bu dang phur mong dkar po'i lo ma bting ba'i dbus su sman snod bzhag /sman snod kyi g.yas g.yon du rdor dril dang*/ phyogs mtshams su me long gdags/ rus rgyan gsol/ dkyil 'khor steng du sman khang nang du bzhugs su gsol/ dar zab kyi gur dbub/ gzungs thag lnga po phyir drangs/ tshangs pa'i dmu thag thog steng du drangs/ gu gul yungs kar sbyar bas bdug /bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad bskor ba bya/ mnga' gsol/ dbang bskur/ bzhu btul dang bdud rtsi'i bstod pa bya/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis bstod/ thun 'dzin pa dang thun bar gyi bya ba sogs sgrub pa'i thabs mtha' dag sgrub chen kyi skabs bshad ma thag pa kho na ltar bya/ bdud rtsi bsgrubs pas grub pa'i rtags gzhung ltar mthong nas/ bdud rtsi bskyil ba dang*/ bdud rtsi dbab pa dang*/ dngos grub dbang du bya ba dang*/ lha gnad la dbab pa dang*/ srid pa dbang du gsol ba rnams bya/ dngos grub blang*/ slob mas dkyil 'khor la me tog dbul/ dbang nod/ pa'i phyir slob mas gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ bdud rtsis slob ma la dbang bskur/ de nas bdud rtsi'i snod dben par spyan drangs la/ rgya dkrol kha dbye zhing dngos grub blangs/ 'jam dpal rnon po la yongs su gtad/ rgya bcag gam gzhal te ji tsam 'phel bar brtags/ slar dkyil 'khor shar du khri'u'i steng du bdud rtsi'i snod bzhag /sman phud cung zad thod par bstsal chang dang sbyar bas srid pa gzu dpang du gsol|

lha rnams la sman mchod rgyas par dbul/ de rjes mched lcam rnams la sman mchod bya/ dngos grub blang zhing gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thig le bya/ bdud rtsi ril bu byas pa spyi bor gdags| yon tan brjod/ de nas bdud rtsi cha gsum du bgo/ cha gcig slob dpon/ cha gcig dkyil 'khor gyi lha/ cha gcig mched lcam rnams la dbul/ dkyil 'khor par mchod bstod| bzod gsol/ bshags pa bya/ sgrub chen dang mi 'brel na ni sman sgrub rang rkang gi sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi bya ba gang dgos sman sgrub rang gi gzhung ltar bya dgos pa yin no// de ltar yang lag len gyi go rim khrigs chags 'di bzhin ma 'phyug pa gter gzhung so so'i go skabs bsgrigs shing bla ma'i phyag bzhes mthong brgyud kyis brgyan pa'i khrigs chags dmar khrid 'phyug med lag len mdo 'gag dgos don snying por dril nas nyams su 'di ltar blang ba gal che yin/ la la dag gis gter gzhung gi dgongs pa dang go rim/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzhes rnams 'chol por yal bar btang*/ rang gi rtog brtags dang sngags gzhung gzhan pa'i bsre lhad/ 'di legs 'di 'os 'di mdzes la snying por byas pa'i sgrub chen la don gnyis 'grub pa'i re ba rnams ni bye ma btsir ba la mar khu 'dod pa kho na lta bur bas kyi gzhan pa'i snying po ci zhig mchis/ smras pa/ zab gsang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lam gyi rim| |dbang sgrub lag len snying po nor bu'i phreng*// 'phyug med go rim gser gyi srad bu 'di// ji bzhin bstar nas ma 'khrul nyams blangs na// don gnyis 'grub pa gshis babs ma yin nam| |kho bo sngon nas grub dbang pad+ma yi// brtse bas mang bzung skye ba mang dag tu// lam 'dir sbyangs 'dris bsgoms shing nyams myong bas// 'khrul med go rim ji bzhin smras 'di dang*| |phal che'i 'thad legs rang bzo gzhal mi mnyam// de ltar bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bsnyen pa/

sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po/ dbang rgyas pa/ sman sgrub dang bcas pa ji ltar nyams su len pa'i go rim lag len nyams yig dmar khrid brjed byang zin bris su byas pa 'di'ang*/ rang nyid kyi brjed ngas dran pa gso ba dang*/ phyi rabs kyi skal ldan lam zab mo 'dir mos pa rnams 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang the tshom gyi 'ching ba gcod pa'i slad du/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis lho brag smra'o cog po nas spyan drangs pa'i bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub chen mo'i pra khrid ṭī ka'i dbang chog rin chen phreng ba/ dus kyi bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa/ rim pa dbang gi sgrub pa/ dbang bum gyi byang bu rnams kyi go rim dang legs par bstun| rje btsun rat+na sam+pan+na dharma rā dza de nyid kyis rig 'dzin las 'phro gling pa ā nan+da shrī bha dra dang*/ mnga' ris glo bo pa rje rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje ste/ dam pa gnyis las legs par gsan pa'i phyag len bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dang*/ sman sgrub kyi nyams yig dmar byang zin bris ltar dang*/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu rgyal dbang dharma rā dza sam+pan+na maṅga la shrī bha dra zhes bka' drin gyi phung po gzhal du med pa de nyid kyis/ pho brang sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu gyi na ba rang nyid la bde 'dus kyi dbang sgrub sman sgrub dang dbang lung khrid lag len dang bcas pa dgyes bzhin du bstsal ba'i skabs kyi phyag bzhes dri ma dang bral ba rnams ma brjed par snying gi ze'u 'brur bkod pa rnams lhan cig tu 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las/ dus mthar son pa'i dge slong sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes sam/ ming gzhan rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo nga bzhi pa sa pho byi ba'i lo sa ga zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i rgyal ba gnyis pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can la/

'bri dam pa chos phyug gi klung gi pho brang chen po rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas su sbyar ba 'dis mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams lam bzang 'di dang mi 'bral bar nyams su blang nas kun bzang che mchog he ru ka'i go 'phang bzang po bde blag nyid du thob par gyur cig gu// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
